name: The Sword and the Fox
source:
The Sword and the Fox is a story about a young swordsman named Junko, who goes to seek sword left in the supposedly haunted castle of a former emperor and meets princess Hayami, a kitsune beast women, who now lives there. Your goal is to guide Junko through this journey to find the sword and find out who this kitsune is and why she invited you in.

[From [url=https://megadrivesonic.itch.io/the-sword-and-the-fox]Itch.io[/url]]
